ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.fix: It lasts as long as the convalescence. Rest in bed shortens it by a third, and working while still weak can set it back. A visit from a friend helps the mood in the meantime.
Time, and company: a friend's visit or a good talk helps. Good medicine and a clean hospital bed make the next loss less likely. A dilemma may let the doctor take a day away.

ColonyCouncil.MoodHintDef.keep: A doctor the colony trusts puts patients at ease each time they tend them; friends who visit the sickbed lift both moods.
